title: PR #44254 — perps order book on the order entry page
description: Proves the TAT-3309 acceptance criteria and the PR body's Gherkin claims against the live extension: collapsed by default, expandable by click, feature-flag gated, price levels + USD totals on both sides, responsive compact/expanded layouts, no regression to the existing order form fields, resizable split (mouse + keyboard), grouping/denomination config, tap-a-price limit prefill, and a fresh ladder after a market switch.

setup-status.intent: Resolve the Extension checkout and adapter status before order-book proof

setup-cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Ensure the wallet is unlocked before opening the perps order entry page

setup-expanded-viewport.intent: Pin a deterministic expanded (fullscreen) viewport so the layout proofs are reproducible

setup-expanded-viewport-exit.intent: Fail early if the expanded viewport could not be applied

setup-open-perps.intent: Leave any previously mounted order entry page so the order book starts from its default state

ac1-navigate-order-entry.intent: AC1: open the perps order entry page for ETH

ac1-wait-order-entry-page.intent: AC1: confirm the order entry page is mounted

ac1-wait-toggle-affordance.intent: AC1: confirm the order-book expand affordance is present in the market header

ac1-assert-book-collapsed.intent: AC1: assert the order-book panel is NOT rendered on arrival (collapsed by default)

ac1-assert-divider-collapsed.intent: AC1: assert the resize divider is absent while the panel is collapsed

ac1-screenshot-collapsed-by-default.intent: AC1: capture the default collapsed state of the order entry page
ac1-screenshot-collapsed-by-default.label: AC1: order entry page on arrival — order form fills the width, no order-book panel, only the collapsed toggle in the header.

ac2-press-toggle.intent: AC2: click the order-book toggle in the market header to expand the panel

ac2-wait-panel-visible.intent: AC2: confirm the order-book panel mounted after the click

ac2-wait-divider-visible.intent: AC2: confirm the resizable split divider appeared with the expanded panel

ac2-wait-ask-ladder.intent: AC2: wait for the full live ask ladder (5 levels) so the panel shows real book depth, not a skeleton

ac2-wait-bid-ladder.intent: AC2/PR1: wait for the full live bid ladder (5 levels)

ac2-wait-spread-row.intent: PR1: confirm the mid spread row renders between the asks and the bids

ac2-wait-depth-ratio.intent: AC2/PR1: confirm the buy/sell depth ratio rendered under the ladder

ac2-screenshot-expanded-order-book.intent: AC2/AC4/PR1: capture the expanded order book as the result of the click
ac2-screenshot-expanded-order-book.label: AC2 + AC4 + PR1: after clicking the header toggle the panel is expanded beside the form — asks above the spread row, bids below, depth bars, buy/sell ratio, and the 'Price / Total (USD)' columns showing USD totals for both sides.

ac4-wait-ask-value.intent: AC4: confirm the ask side renders its value column

ac4-wait-bid-value.intent: AC4: confirm the bid side renders its value column

ac4-assert-usd-total-header.intent: AC4: assert the value column is explicitly labelled as a USD total

ac4-assert-usd-values.intent: AC4: assert every rendered ask AND bid row carries a USD-formatted value, not just the header

ac4-assert-usd-values-exit.intent: AC4: fail the run if any displayed ask/bid row is missing a USD value

ac4-assert-usd-values-output.intent: AC4: record that both sides rendered their full depth with USD values

ac6-assert-order-type-toggle.intent: AC6: the Market/Limit order-type control still renders beside the open book

ac6-assert-amount-field.intent: AC6: the size/amount field still renders beside the open book

ac6-assert-leverage-control.intent: AC6: the leverage control still renders beside the open book

ac6-assert-tpsl-control.intent: AC6: the TP/SL (auto-close) control still renders beside the open book

ac6-assert-submit-button.intent: AC6: the submit control still renders beside the open book

ac6-screenshot-form-fields-intact.intent: AC6: capture the order form intact beside the expanded order book
ac6-screenshot-form-fields-intact.label: AC6: with the order book expanded, the order form keeps its direction tabs, Market/Limit toggle, size field, leverage control, TP/SL (auto-close) section, order summary and submit button.

ac6-run-order-form-regression-tests.intent: AC6: run the existing order-form hook suites that own limit price, size and leverage state

ac6-assert-order-form-exit.intent: AC6: the pre-existing order-form suites must still pass with the prefill wiring added

ac6-assert-order-form-suites-passed.intent: AC6: prove both pre-existing order-form suites actually ran and passed, not just that the process exited 0

pr2-focus-divider.intent: PR2: focus the resize divider so the trusted key presses are delivered to it (clicking it does not focus it — handleOrderBookResizeStart calls preventDefault on mousedown)

pr2-assert-focus-exit.intent: PR2: fail the run if the divider cannot take keyboard focus at all

pr2-key-arrow-left.intent: PR2: ArrowLeft widens the right-aligned order book by one step

pr2-assert-arrow-widened.intent: PR2: the split moved from the 33% default to 35% — one 2-point arrow step

pr2-key-end.intent: PR2: End jumps the divider to the minimum bound

pr2-assert-end-at-min.intent: PR2: the split is clamped to the 22% minimum bound and stops there

pr2-key-home.intent: PR2: Home jumps the divider to the maximum bound

pr2-assert-home-at-max.intent: PR2: assert Home lands exactly on the announced maximum bound

pr2-assert-home-exit.intent: PR2: fail the run if Home does not reach the announced ceiling

pr2-key-end-before-drag.intent: PR2: return the split to its minimum so the following mouse drag starts away from the ceiling

pr2-assert-at-min-before-drag.intent: PR2: confirm the drag starts from the 22% minimum, so any movement is attributable to the drag

pr2-drag-divider.intent: PR2: perform a real mouse drag on the divider, past the ceiling, to prove resize and clamping

pr2-assert-drag-exit.intent: PR2: fail the run if the drag does not resize the split or escapes the min/max bounds

pr2-assert-drag-output.intent: PR2: record the before/after split percentages and the bounds honoured

pr2-screenshot-resized-split.intent: PR2: capture the resized split sitting on its clamped bound
pr2-screenshot-resized-split.label: PR2: after keyboard resizing (ArrowLeft/End/Home) and a mouse drag dragged far past the ceiling, the split rests on its clamped maximum — the order form is never collapsed.

pr3-open-config-modal.intent: PR3: open the listing/grouping config modal from the order-book header

pr3-wait-config-modal.intent: PR3: the config modal is open with its denomination pills

pr3-screenshot-config-modal.intent: PR3: capture the grouping/denomination configuration surface
pr3-screenshot-config-modal.label: PR3: the 'Listed by & Group by' modal — denomination (ETH / USD), value type (Size / Total) and the price-grouping increments.

pr3-select-base-currency.intent: PR3: choose the base-asset denomination instead of USD

pr3-select-size-metric.intent: PR3: choose the per-level Size metric instead of the cumulative Total

pr3-apply-config.intent: PR3: apply the new denomination and value metric

pr3-assert-header-updated.intent: PR3: the column header switched from 'Total (USD)' to 'Size (ETH)' after applying

pr3-screenshot-config-applied.intent: PR3: capture the ladder and column headers after the config change
pr3-screenshot-config-applied.label: PR3: after applying the base denomination and the Size metric, the column header reads 'Size (ETH)' and the ladder values are base-asset sizes instead of USD totals.

pr4-tap-ask-price-row.intent: PR4: tap an ask price row to switch the form to a limit order prefilled with that price

pr4-wait-limit-price-field.intent: PR4: the form switched to a Limit order — the limit price field mounted

pr4-assert-prefill-matches.intent: PR4: assert the limit price input holds the price of the row that was tapped, not just any value

pr4-assert-prefill-exit.intent: PR4: fail the run if the limit price does not match the tapped row

pr4-assert-prefill-output.intent: PR4: record the tapped price and the resulting limit price input value

pr4-screenshot-limit-prefilled.intent: PR4: capture the limit order prefilled from an order-book price tap
pr4-screenshot-limit-prefilled.label: PR4: tapping an ask row switched the order type to Limit and prefilled the limit price input with that row's price.

ac5-shrink-browser-window.intent: AC5: shrink the real browser window to its minimum so the OS-level capture frames the compact layout rather than a wide window

ac5-set-compact-viewport.intent: AC5: emulate the compact ~360px popup width so the compact layout is proven visually, not only by unit test

ac5-assert-compact-viewport-exit.intent: AC5: fail the run if the compact viewport could not be applied

ac5-wait-ladder-compact.intent: AC5: the order-book ladder still renders at compact popup width

ac5-wait-form-compact.intent: AC5: the order form still renders beside the book at compact popup width

ac5-assert-pixel-floors.intent: AC5: assert both panes stay above their pixel floors (book 140px, form 224px) at a 360px viewport

ac5-assert-pixel-floors-exit.intent: AC5: fail the run if either pane collapses below its usable width

ac5-assert-pixel-floors-output.intent: AC5: record the measured pane widths at compact width

ac5-screenshot-compact-split.intent: AC5: capture the compact (popup-width) half of the responsive claim
ac5-screenshot-compact-split.label: AC5 (compact half): at a 360px popup-width viewport both panes stay usable — the order book holds its 140px floor and the order form its 224px floor, with the body's horizontal-scroll fallback absorbing the remainder. The expanded/fullscreen half is the AC2 capture.

ac5-restore-expanded-viewport.intent: AC5: restore the expanded viewport before the market-switch proof

pr5-capture-eth-ladder.intent: PR5: snapshot the ETH ladder rows before switching markets

pr5-assert-capture-exit.intent: PR5: fail the run if there was no ETH ladder to compare against

pr5-navigate-btc.intent: PR5: switch to a different market while the order book is open

pr5-assert-fresh-ladder.intent: PR5: assert the ladder shows the new market's rows and that no previous-market row survived the switch

pr5-assert-fresh-exit.intent: PR5: fail the run if any previous-market row is still displayed after the switch

pr5-assert-fresh-output.intent: PR5: record the market transition and the new top-of-book price

pr5-screenshot-btc-ladder.intent: PR5: capture the refreshed ladder for the new market
pr5-screenshot-btc-ladder.label: PR5: after navigating from ETH to BTC with the order book open, the ladder shows the new market's levels — asserted disjoint from the captured ETH rows.

ac3-run-flag-off-hides-toggle-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.test.tsx --no-coverage -t "does not render the order book toggle when the feature flag is off" 2>&1
ac3-run-flag-off-hides-toggle-test.intent: AC3: exercise the flag-OFF render path, which the live slot cannot reach (its fixture pins perpsOrderBookEnabled to enabled:true and remote flags are not writable from a read-only probe)

ac3-assert-flag-off-exit.intent: AC3: the flag-OFF suite run must succeed

ac3-assert-flag-off-test-passed.intent: AC3: prove that named flag-OFF test actually matched and PASSED (a non-existent title yields 0 passed at exit 0, so this discriminates)

ac3-run-flag-selector-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/selectors/perps/feature-flags.test.ts --no-coverage -t "returns false when the perpsOrderBookEnabled flag is absent" 2>&1
ac3-run-flag-selector-test.intent: AC3: prove the gate defaults to OFF when the remote flag is absent entirely (jest -t is a regex, so the title matches without its parenthesised suffix)

ac3-assert-flag-selector-exit.intent: AC3: the selector default-OFF run must succeed

ac3-assert-flag-selector-passed.intent: AC3: prove the getIsPerpsOrderBookEnabled default-OFF assertion matched and PASSED

teardown-collapse-order-book.intent: Collapse the order book so the slot is left in its default state

teardown-clear-viewport.intent: Clear the emulated viewport override so the slot is left unmodified

teardown-return-perps-home.intent: Return the slot to the perps home surface

ac5-restore-browser-window.intent: AC5: restore the original browser window size after the compact-layout capture

setup-clear-stale-capture-helpers.intent: Kill orphaned capture-helper processes: leftovers hold the macOS capture session and force ui.screenshot to fall back to Page.captureScreenshot, which is not valid review evidence

ac1-clear-capture-before-screenshot-coll.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before ac1-screenshot-collapsed-by-default so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

ac2-clear-capture-before-screenshot-expa.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before ac2-screenshot-expanded-order-book so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

ac6-clear-capture-before-screenshot-form.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before ac6-screenshot-form-fields-intact so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

pr2-clear-capture-before-screenshot-resi.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before pr2-screenshot-resized-split so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

pr3-clear-capture-before-screenshot-conf.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before pr3-screenshot-config-modal so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback
Free the macOS capture session immediately before pr3-screenshot-config-applied so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

pr4-clear-capture-before-screenshot-limi.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before pr4-screenshot-limit-prefilled so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

ac5-clear-capture-before-screenshot-comp.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before ac5-screenshot-compact-split so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback

pr5-clear-capture-before-screenshot-btc-.intent: Free the macOS capture session immediately before pr5-screenshot-btc-ladder so ui.screenshot uses capture-helper instead of the Page.captureScreenshot fallback
